E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Clean Out Your Junk Drawer: Gloria wins a bid at the school auction for a family seminar with famous doctor and self-help book author Debra Radcliffe. (S7 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Gump Roast: Aliens Kang and Kodos decide that Homer is the 'fat, selfish epitome of modern man' and that Earth must be destroyed. Guest starring Stephen Hawking and U2. (S13 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: I Am Furious Yellow: Bart becomes an animator and finds inspiration close to home when he creates his lead character: Angry Dad. (S13 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Little Girl in the Big Ten: Lisa pretends to be a student so that she can hang out with some college girls. Meanwhile, Bart is bitten by a mosquito. (S13 Ep20)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Frying Game: Homer and Marge are framed for murder and face the electric chair. Guest starring Carmen Electra as herself. (S13 Ep21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer vs Dignity: Homer asks Mr Burns for a pay rise after the family have to dress up as a mariachi band and sing for their dinner. But Mr Burns has a better idea... (S12 Ep5/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Willard R. Abbott: Ava and Janine are delighted when the school is named a historical landmark, but it highlights the fact that it's named after a racist... (S3 Ep6/14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Just Infatuation: Will and Carlton spy on Ashley when she goes on a date with famous young rapper Little T. (S1 Ep24/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air
E4Plus1.uk.description: Working It Out: To keep her new job as personal assistant to a film star (guest star Queen Latifah), Hilary has to agree to a date with Will's best friend, Jazz. Series finale. (S1 Ep25/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Inbetweeners Movie
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2011) Outrageous comedy with Simon Bird, Joe Thomas, Blake Harrison and James Buckley. School is over, so the boys celebrate with a scandalous lads' holiday in Crete.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Dating Naked USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: With the experience nearing an end, Kerri's realised that her feelings for Chris have grown, even though she's also smitten with her new man. So she decides to tell Chris. (S2 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Pansexual Sarah can't wait to road test her new body on her first date as a woman. Plumber Jamie's love life has gone down the U-bend, so he's all cisterns go to find a partner. (S11 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: On the 'Box: Heartstopper, Strictly Come Dancing, The Dog House, Slow Horses, Nadiya's Cook Once Eat Twice, and Will & Ralf Should Know Better. (S24 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Below Deck Down Under
E4Plus1.uk.description: An over-the-top guest has the crew scrambling all over the place. Meanwhile, Captain Jason's resolved to keep his distance. Wise move, skip... (S4 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Abbott Elementary
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series - Willard R. Abbott: Ava and Janine are delighted when the school is named a historical landmark, but it highlights the fact that it's named after a racist... (S3 Ep6/14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Computer Wore Menace Shoes: After Homer publishes damaging rumours on 'Mr X's Web Page', he ends up on a Prisoner-style island, complete with guest star Patrick McGoohan. (S12 Ep6/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Hooters: Adam and Murray fall out over Adam's plans to pursue a comedy career after his act in woodwork class nearly results in his teacher getting injured. (S5 Ep13) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hail Barry: Despite his lack of sporting prowess, Barry tries to join the school football team. (S5 Ep14) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Leone's: Rose built her Italian restaurant in New Jersey into a thriving business, but when she spent two years in hospital, her son ran it into the ground. Can Gordon save it? (S5 Ep2) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Oktoberfest One: Sofia dreams of a boho beach blessing, but Craig wants an Oktoberfest wedding with short leather trousers. Will Sofia end the nuptials?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One in the Spanish Sea: Carl plans to marry Rebecca on the Med but she's expecting a high-class affair. Will Carl's plans make a splash and make Rebecca swoon with delight?

E4Plus1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Chuggs can't get Rosie out of his head. Freddy makes a confession. Jazz finds herself on good terms with Inga. And can Maali finally get closure from Sam Prince? (S32 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burger Kitchen (Part 1/2): In the first half of a two-part Nightmare, Gordon tries to save a burger joint in LA, run by a dysfunctional family in a state of constant conflict. (S5 Ep3)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Burger Kitchen (Part 2/2): In the second half of a two-part Nightmare in LA, can Gordon Ramsay bring together the fragmented Saffron family and save their failing restaurant? (S5 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Luigi's: Gordon Ramsay travels to Orange County, Southern California, to try to save Italian restaurant Luigi's from disaster. (S5 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Park's Edge: In Atlanta, Gordon helps first-time restaurant owners Richard and Jorge, whose establishment is in trouble due to their constant fighting, poor food and bad vibes. (S5 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Greek at the Harbor: Gordon Ramsay helps a family-run Greek restaurant turn its fortunes around in Ventura Harbor in California. But he uncovers a shocking family secret... (S5 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Tale of Two Springfields: When class rivalries split Springfield in two, Homer becomes mayor of 'New Springfield'. (S12 Ep2/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Insane Clown Poppy: Homer and Bart take Lisa to a book fair, where Krusty meets his long-lost daughter (guest star Drew Barrymore). But it doesn't go well... (S12 Ep3/21)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer the Heretic: Homer has a vision from God and decides to start his own religion, which doesn't go down too well with the neighbours. (S4 Ep3/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lisa the Beauty Queen: Lisa wins second place in a beauty contest. (S4 Ep4/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror III: Lisa, Grampa and Bart tell scary stories at their Halloween party. A Krusty doll comes alive. Mr Burns heads to Skull Island. Bart raises the dead. (S4 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Itchy and Scratchy: The Movie: While Homer and Marge are at parents' evening, Bart breaks the babysitter's teeth. So Homer vows never to let him see the Itchy and Scratchy film. (S4 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge Gets a Job: When Marge gets a job at the power plant, Mr Burns falls in love with her and invites her over to dinner, complete with a kidnapped Tom Jones to serenade them. (S4 Ep7/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: New Kid on the Block: When Homer gets kicked out of an all-you-can-eat seafood restaurant for eating too much, he takes the owner to court. (S4 Ep8/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons Movie
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2007) Animated comedy. When Homer's love for a pig causes world-threatening pollution, Springfield gets enclosed in a huge dome. D'oh! Will he do the decent thing and save his neighbours?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Great Christmas Bake Off
E4Plus1.uk.description: Paul Hollywood and Prue Leith get festive with bakers of Christmas past Sophie, Dan, Amelia, Linda, George and Carole, and a performance from the Citizens of the World Choir.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox Festive Special
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's favourite armchair critics review Christmas TV, from Strictly to Gavin & Stacey, First Dates, Hot Frosty, Bullseye, The Dog House, Is It Cake? and Fanny Cradock. (S24 Ep16)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's Britain's Got Talent, Celebrity Hunted and Coronation Street on the 'Box this time. Plus: One Question, Boarders, The Fear Clinic, and Donald Trump on the News. (S25 Ep3)
